lines.text: Marian bolts upright in bed.
She quickly walks out of the room and goes downstairs.
She finds Doctor Maria sitting at the desk.
Doctor Maria has her head in her hands and an alcohol glass in front of her.
She lets out a long, deep sigh, then senses Marian's presence and looks up.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... Congratulations. You reached the target location.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: We can officially say you're a bit closer to reaching Liliweiss's level.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: We'll be changing the location moving forward.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: You'll continue running tests in the new environment.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Of course, the Rapture density and threat level will increase, but that means the data will be even more—

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: So that wasn't the end.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: No. There's no way it would end just because you reached the target location.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: You lied to me. To us.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... I never once said that arriving there meant it'd be over.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: How long do I have to keep doing this?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... I don't know.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Doctor!

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I don't know either!

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I have no clue! None! Okay?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I... I thought it would be over too.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: But then, as if on cue, I was told to try a new setting, as though that had been the plan all along. What am I supposed to do?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: "We haven't succeeded yet, so let's try a different approach." What am I supposed to do with that?!

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Haven't succeeded... at what?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... I can't tell you.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: There's another objective apart from recreating Liliweiss, isn't there?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... Yeah, there is. But I can't tell you what it is. It's beyond top secret.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: ... And when does that end?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I have no idea.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: We have to keep going until we're told it's done.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: ... What is it you want to do so badly that you'd corrupt me?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: You... knew...!

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: How could I not? It'd be weird if I didn't.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: My memory suddenly cuts off in places.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: And the Commander sometimes gets this fear of me in his eyes.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Also, that "enhancement procedure" doesn't enhance anything.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: It'd be awfully hard not to notice any of that.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: But, if you knew all this time... why...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: ... Because you wanted it, Doctor.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: So I held on. I gritted my teeth every time I got scared getting into that machine.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I tried not to think about all the times and ways the Commander might have died by my hand.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I kept it together as I watched the Commander pretend not to notice.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: And I continued to hold on even as I started to hate myself for having to act like nothing was wrong with me.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: All because you wanted it.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: But now I don't know anymore.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I don't know what you want.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: if you even want anything at all.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Doctor.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Continuing the tests...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Is that what you really want?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... Yes. That's what I want.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Look at me, Doctor.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Is that really what you want?
Doctor Maria looks at Marian's face.
But then she quickly looks away.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I have to clear my mother's name.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: That's all I was made for.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: It's my fate!

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: And this is the only way to accomplish that.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: If I give this up, then everything I've done until now...

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: My whole reason for living is just...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Doctor.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: We're going to run away.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: We're going to stop doing all this, and we're going to run.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Help us.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: We can't run.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: We're involved in something far bigger than us.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: We couldn't run if we tried.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Our only choice is to keep living like this.
Marian squeezes her eyes shut.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Do you know what I see when I close my eyes?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I see the Commander.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I see his smile, his gestures... I hear his voice.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: But then I start to imagine.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I imagine this continuing on, and how all of that would eventually disappear if it did.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: That smile will turn to despair, those gestures will fill with rage, and that voice will carry only frustration.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: The Commander I know now will disappear without a trace.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: ... I don't want that.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Just thinking about it breaks my heart.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: The thought of losing the person who's become my reason for living terrifies me.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: So...
Marian opens her eyes and looks at Doctor Maria.
She gets on her knees.
She clasps her hands together and looks up,
like someone praying to their creator.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Please...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Help us.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I'm begging you. Please...

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Mari...an...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I had given up on everything. But he pulled me back up.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I found something I want to do. For the first time, I have something I actually want.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I want to live with the Commander.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: No. No, Marian.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: You're the same as me. You're just being manipulated by a greater force.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: You're mistaking it for your own will.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: That can't be true.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: It's my heart that wants this.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: The desire is all mine.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: It wasn't made or decided by anyone else.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: It's mine and mine alone.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: So please, help us.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Help us so that we can live our own lives.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I... can't... There's... nothing we can do.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: We can't break free.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Then... then...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Look... I... I don't care what happens to me.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: B-but please... please let the Commander live.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Help him to live an actual life.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I'm begging you, with all my heart. Okay?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Please, Doctor...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Help... the Commander.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: That's all I ask...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I'm pleading with you... Please.
Doctor Maria looks at Marian pleading before her.
She squeezes her eyes shut.
Images flash through her mind.
She sees Marian dying again and again.
She sees Marian succumbing to despair and throwing everything away.
She sees Marian terrified of death.
And...
She sees Marian smiling,
her eyes full of love,
her footsteps light.
She hears her voice speaking of the future.
She sees Marian being happy.
She sees Marian in a wedding dress, with the most joyful expression in the world.
She sees her creation,
doing all she can to find happiness.
And she knows, without a doubt,
that these desires are Marian's alone.
She admired her. Envied her.
Doctor Maria had always accepted everything as fate, without trying to change a thing, so when she compared herself to her creation,
she found herself jealous, wishing she could be like her.
And now that creation is there in front of her, pleading with her creator.
The thing Doctor Maria had envied is kneeling before her, desperately asking...
Begging...
Pouring her heart out in the hope of getting what she wants.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Ah... Ahhh...

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: How... How is it you can be so...

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Human...

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Actually... no.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: You've never been an object.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: You've always been a person.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Someone trying to forge her own fate.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: A better person than me.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Doctor...?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Here you are, this person,

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: and yet I kept pushing you toward death like it was nothing.
Doctor Maria slowly helps Marian to her feet.
She looks straight into Marian's eyes.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... I shouldn't have made you a fighter.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Being this smart, I should've just made you follow in my footsteps instead.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: If I had... If I'd just done that, you wouldn't have died all of those times. You would've worked in a comfortable office.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: You would've been so good at it, too. I bet you would've become someone really remarkable.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: You would've discovered what you want even sooner.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: You would've dreamed of a better future, and at this point you would've seen it starting to blossom.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: My inhuman greed ruined you.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: It ruined your... many lives.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Doctor...!

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I'm sorry, Marian.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: It's already too late. I've let this inhuman greed of mine carry me way too far.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: But, even so...

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I'll grant you your wish, if nothing else.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I promise to at least give you that.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... It's what I want.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I learned to have a will from you, my creation.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: And now this desire is mine, and mine alone.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: So I will see it through.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I will grant you your wish.
